description: This file defines the interface for the VM manager component in the Cuttlefish project, including the VmManager class, constants related to virtual device configuration, and function declarations for managing VM configurations.

classes.name: VmmDependencyCommand
classes.description: A class for tagging that the CommandSource is a dependency command for the VmManager.

classes.name: VmManager
classes.description: An abstract base class representing the interface for VM management, including configuration, startup, and restore operations.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the VM manager is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: ConfigureGraphics
methods.description: Configures graphics settings for a VM instance.

methods.name: ConfigureBootDevices
methods.description: Configures boot devices for a VM instance.

methods.name: StartCommands
methods.description: Starts the VM by building and executing the necessary commands.

methods.name: WaitForRestoreComplete
methods.description: Blocks until the restore process is complete and the VM is running.
